title: West Cloister
shortDescription: Rain-dark arches frame a walk of moss and old promises.
longDescription:
Stone arches shelter a narrow walk beside the court. Moss holds the rain in bright beads, and the worn paving dips where generations of Collegians have paused to watch the weather.
A promise mosaic fills a shallow niche: hands, paws, wings, and leaves fitted from mismatched pieces of pottery. No two tiles are quite alike, yet the circle holds.

fixtures.name: Promise Mosaic
fixtures.examineDescription: The small tiles make an unbroken ring around the words: 'We care for what we share.' A cracked blue piece has been repaired with pale mortar instead of replaced. Its break remains visible, and the whole pattern is stronger around it.
